record.title: Oriented cursor follows the remaining aligned waypoints
record.written_solution: Select the panel after the last full-height separator. Identify the three-cell cursor tip. Repeatedly consume the unique remaining waypoint sharing its row or column. Render a clean panel with the cursor at the final waypoint, oriented along the final leg. Earlier panels are context and do not influence this variant's output.
record.program_solution:
(rule!
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define sep-cols
    (filter
     (lambda (c)
      (and (!= (at g 0 c) bg)
           (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) (at g 0 c))) (range 0 h))))
     (range 0 w)))
   (define start (+ 1 (apply max sep-cols)))
   (define panel (subgrid g 0 start (- h 1) (- w 1)))
   (define pw (cols panel))
   (define objs (objects-8 panel bg))
   (define cursor (first (filter (lambda (o) (> (obj-size o) 1)) objs)))
   (define cells (obj-cells cursor))
   (define bb (obj-bbox cursor))
   (define bh (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))))
   (define bw (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))))
   (define tip
    (if (> bw bh)
        (first
         (filter
          (lambda (p)
           (= 1 (count-if (lambda (q) (= (first q) (first p))) cells)))
          cells))
        (first
         (filter
          (lambda (p)
           (= 1 (count-if (lambda (q) (= (second q) (second p))) cells)))
          cells))))
   (define dots
    (map (lambda (o) (first (obj-cells o)))
         (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) 1)) objs)))
   (define traced
    (let loop ((pos tip) (remaining dots) (last-delta (list 0 0)))
     (if (empty? remaining)
         (list pos last-delta)
         (let* ((aligned
                 (filter
                  (lambda (q)
                   (or (= (first q) (first pos))
                       (= (second q) (second pos))))
                  remaining))
                (next (first aligned))
                (delta (list (- (first next) (first pos))
                             (- (second next) (second pos)))))
          (loop next
                (filter (lambda (q) (not (equal? q next))) remaining)
                delta)))))
   (define final (first traced))
   (define delta (second traced))
   (define r (first final))
   (define c (second final))
   (define arrow
    (cond ((< (first delta) 0)
           (list (list r c) (list (+ r 1) (- c 1)) (list (+ r 1) (+ c 1))))
          ((> (first delta) 0)
           (list (list r c) (list (- r 1) (- c 1)) (list (- r 1) (+ c 1))))
          ((< (second delta) 0)
           (list (list r c) (list (- r 1) (+ c 1)) (list (+ r 1) (+ c 1))))
          (else
           (list (list r c) (list (- r 1) (- c 1)) (list (+ r 1) (- c 1))))))
   (paint-cells (empty-grid h pw bg) arrow (obj-color cursor)))))

record.title: Typed cursor follows the remaining final-panel waypoint route
record.written_solution: Take the panel after the last full-height separator. Identify its two-cell cursor: the head shares its color with the singleton waypoints, while the other color is the tail. Repeatedly move the head to the uniquely aligned unconsumed waypoint. After the last hop, return a clean panel containing the head at that waypoint and the tail one cell opposite the final travel direction. Earlier panels are unused context in this semantic variant.
record.program_solution:
(rule!
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define sep-cols
    (filter
     (lambda (c)
      (and (!= (at g 0 c) bg)
           (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) (at g 0 c))) (range 0 h))))
     (range 0 w)))
   (define start (+ 1 (apply max sep-cols)))
   (define panel (subgrid g 0 start (- h 1) (- w 1)))
   (define pw (cols panel))
   (define objs (objects-multicolor panel bg))
   (define cursor (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) 2)) objs)))
   (define cells (obj-cells cursor))
   (define singles
    (map (lambda (o) (first (obj-cells o)))
         (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) 1)) objs)))
   (define head
    (first
     (filter
      (lambda (p)
       (> (count-if
           (lambda (q) (= (at panel (first q) (second q))
                          (at panel (first p) (second p))))
           singles)
          0))
      cells)))
   (define tail (first (filter (lambda (p) (not (equal? p head))) cells)))
   (define head-color (at panel (first head) (second head)))
   (define tail-color (at panel (first tail) (second tail)))
   (define dots
    (filter
     (lambda (p) (= (at panel (first p) (second p)) head-color))
     singles))
   (define traced
    (let loop ((pos head) (remaining dots) (last-delta (list 0 0)))
     (if (empty? remaining)
         (list pos last-delta)
         (let* ((aligned
                 (filter
                  (lambda (q)
                   (or (= (first q) (first pos))
                       (= (second q) (second pos))))
                  remaining))
                (next (first aligned))
                (delta (list (- (first next) (first pos))
                             (- (second next) (second pos)))))
          (loop next
                (filter (lambda (q) (not (equal? q next))) remaining)
                delta)))))
   (define final (first traced))
   (define delta (second traced))
   (define dr (cond ((< (first delta) 0) -1)
                    ((> (first delta) 0) 1)
                    (else 0)))
   (define dc (cond ((< (second delta) 0) -1)
                    ((> (second delta) 0) 1)
                    (else 0)))
   (define r (first final))
   (define c (second final))
   (set-cell
    (set-cell (empty-grid h pw bg) r c head-color)
    (- r dr) (- c dc) tail-color))))
